Definition: diminutive from G5475; a copper dish:--brazen vessel.
BiblicalUsage: Chalkion is a copper dish, a brazen vessel — and it appears once, in the washings of the Pharisees, who would not eat without washing, and kept the washing of cups and pots and brazen vessels and tables.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the copper dish is the picture of religion that washes the outside and never touches the inside.
